'''Benb''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Benb served as a civilian sensor technician aboard the warship ''[[Leveler]]''. He was aboard the ''Leveler'' when it traveled to the [[Fath system]], to rescue the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Hallena Devis]], who had been captured on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[JanFathal]]. Benb changed the [[transponder]] of one of the ''Leveler''{{'s}} civilian [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to give it the transponder code of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] landing craft, to enable a rescue team to land on the planet. While he worked, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to check that Devis was still alive. Benb worried that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would put him out of a job, so [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Leveler'', promised to give the technician a pay rise. When the ''Leveler''s [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] failed, Pellaeon called Benb to the bridge and Benb explained that the failure was due to a problem with the hyperdrives [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]].
